rca_of_the_issue.original_root_cause: splashHidden variable was used but never declared as a state variable, causing the AdMob useEffect to always return early (undefined is falsy).
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Line 115 now declares splashHidden as useState(false), and useEffect at lines 404-409 sets it to true when app is ready.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All code paths verified - the fix is correctly implemented and the initialization chain is complete.
